objective: Append authoritative created records after successful JSON writes and recover cleanly from transport/body errors.

Update all three boards,skeleton/hint/method;reference uses local UUID keys,junior stable append-only indices,and senior keeps extracted helper/UUID while adding catch/error state. Do not require a production backend or actual remote writes. Visible controlled repeated-id/returned-title case and three hidden cases verify six sequential deferred writes,pending duplicate suppression,request body/headers,exact literal/duplicate/long response titles,stable nodes,HTTP/network/JSON failure/retry and independent lifetimes.
